steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration
steps.description: Configure application properties such as app name 'Smart Notes' and unique package identifier 'com.smartnotes.app' in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings with Gradle
steps.description: Establish build configurations using Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2. Define compile and target SDK versions to 34 and min SDK to 21 with standard Java 8 compatibility settings.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml specifying 'com.smartnotes.app' as namespace, setting MainActivity as the launcher entry point, and enforcing the standard Material Light theme and icon reference.

steps.title: Define Theme Colors
steps.description: Create a color resources file containing material colors for primary elements, background highlights, borders, and text accents.

steps.title: Define Text String Resources
steps.description: Establish key-value string references for labels, placeholder texts, button captions, dialog alerts, and menu items to support scalable application labeling.

steps.title: Establish the SQLite Database Schema
steps.description: Develop the DatabaseHelper helper class using native Android SQLite APIs to create, read, update, and delete notes and categories.

steps.title: Create Main Activity UI Layout
steps.description: Design user interfaces including a Dual-View system (List view & Form Editor view), featuring custom search box, category dropdown spinners, list visualizers, and control buttons.

steps.title: Create Custom Notes List Item View Layout
steps.description: Formulate a custom list item layout detailing title, note snippet, timestamp, category tag, and integrated control buttons for quick modification or deletion.

steps.title: Implement Database Core Integration in MainActivity
steps.description: Initialize database adapters inside MainActivity, load default note categories (General, Personal, Work, Ideas) on the first boot up of the app, and prepare operational lists.

steps.title: Implement Note Listing and Filtering Logic
steps.description: Add functionality inside MainActivity to populate the note list, filter list content programmatically based on the selected category spinner, and refresh listings dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Search Real-Time Filter System
steps.description: Write a text watcher implementation targeting the search bar to query and filter list results instantly on key-press input events.

steps.title: Implement Note Creation and Management Flow
steps.description: Integrate code logic to transition UI to the custom editor state on click of the action button, configure categories selector, validate blank forms, and write clean database inserts.

steps.title: Implement Note Edit and Modification Logic
steps.description: Wire existing note records from lists back into the UI fields when clicking on lists, pre-select stored attributes, and process update callbacks.

steps.title: Implement Deletion Actions and Prompts
steps.description: Integrate interactive confirmation modals preventing accidental deletions, allowing users to safely purge note items instantly using localized handlers.

steps.title: Implement Category Creation Dynamic Dialogue
steps.description: Build an integrated dialog popup routine that allows users to instantly append custom categories to the global list and immediately update UI spinners dynamically.

steps.title: Review Java 8 and Manifest Validation Rules
steps.description: Execute an API compliance check to verify that no unsupported modern expressions (lambdas, method references) or invalid non-standard schemas exist across codebase.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Initiate automated project building and validation using standard build tools.
